string-array.name: moon_egg_lines
string-array.item: The moon has been watching your firmwares boot. It is very proud.
Somewhere in this valley, a Gingerbread phone is still optimizing apps.
Full moon reached. Your emulator now runs 0% faster, but feels 100% calmer.
Shh… the old Androids are sleeping under the stars.
You found the secret valley. Tell no one. (Or tell everyone.)

resources.string: Welcome to the Moon Valley museum. Walk through every Android version, from the first phone with a slide-out keyboard to the newest release. Each exhibit wears the colours of its era.
Android is a trademark of Google LLC. Codenames marked "internal" were used inside Google and not as public names.

The e-ink back screen, as the firmware draws it. It refreshes every 2 seconds; touch on it is not supported yet.
